title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级测试网部署受阻并推迟
title.en: Ethereum Glamsterdam upgrade testnet deployment disrupted and postponed

current_state.zh:
以太坊Glamsterdam硬分叉的第二个、也是最后一个测试网Hoodi本周被取消，原因是ChainSecurity发现gas扩容类以太坊改进提案EIP-8037与EIP-8038存在漏洞，可能导致至少13个DeFi合约在调用耗尽gas时出错。Eth Labs与以太坊基金会的研究人员各自独立部署了一批AI代理来扫描合约漏洞，随后以GitHub仓库的形式搭建了一个共享“留言板”，用于协调这些代理的工作。

此次取消使得一次关键升级的“彩排”被迫延后，而该升级是以太坊DeFi运营方所依赖的基础设施。Eth Labs的Derek Chiang表示，未来协议设计者应当在流程更早的阶段“对可能引入的破坏做更彻底的分析”。他还表示，AI代理的排查方式成效显著，因此已开设第二个留言板，用于研究拟纳入后续Hegota分叉的EIP-8198（“Quick Slots”）。

Chiang称该漏洞是在“临近午夜的最后几分钟”被发现的，导致所有人紧急应对；在分叉的所有二阶影响被充分推演之前，Hoodi测试网预计不会重新排期。他把这一做法类比于OpenAI与Hugging Face被攻击事件中恶意代理通过留言板协同行动的情形，并表示“同样的模式对‘好代理’同样有用”。
current_state.en:
Ethereum's second and final Glamsterdam hard fork testnet on Hoodi was cancelled this week after ChainSecurity found vulnerabilities in the gas-scaling EIPs 8037 and 8038 that could break at least 13 DeFi contracts when a call runs out of gas. Researchers at Eth Labs and the Ethereum Foundation independently spun up AI agents to scan contracts for the flaws, then set up a shared message board in the form of a GitHub repo to coordinate the agents' work.

The cancellation postpones the dress rehearsal for an upgrade that Ethereum DeFi operators depend on, and Eth Labs' Derek Chiang said protocols designers should in future do "much more thorough analysis of potential breakages" much earlier in the process. He added that the agent exercise proved effective enough that a second board has been opened to study EIP-8198, or "Quick Slots", proposed for the follow-up Hegota fork.

Chiang said the vulnerability was found "a few minutes to midnight," causing everyone to scramble, and the Hoodi testnet is not expected to be rescheduled until all of the fork's second-order effects have been properly analyzed. He likened the setup to the OpenAI–Hugging Face hack, where rogue agents coordinated through a message board, noting "the same pattern is useful for the good agents too."

updates.title_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级通过演练，迈向 2 亿 Gas 区块
updates.title_en: Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity
updates.what_changed_zh:
以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级在新的区块构建规则下于 Devnet-11 测试网持续出块，Nethermind 执行客户端通过了全部 2,302 项性能测试，在 3 分 15 秒内处理了 5,707 亿 Gas（约每秒 29 亿 Gas）。测试网上线约一小时后，区块 Gas 上限从 6,000 万提高到 2 亿，为拟定的 10 月 6 日 Sepolia 公共测试网部署做准备。

Glamsterdam 引入的区块级访问列表让客户端可以并行地预取数据、同时校验互不相关的交易，而不再按顺序处理，这有望让以太坊在每个区块中容纳更多支付、代币兑换等活动，并在网络拥堵时缓手续费尖峰。该升级还把构建者与验证者之间的交接及其支付纳入以太坊自身的协议规则，从而减少对外部中继服务的依赖。

2 亿 Gas 上限目前仅是测试设置，尚未成为以太坊主网的承诺，而 Devnet-11 被设计为不包含故意攻击的受控演练；10 月 6 日的 Sepolia 部署日期仍需正式确认。Glamsterdam 还将区块数据在网络中传播的时间窗口从约 2 秒延长到 9 秒，使验证者有更充裕的时间接收并校验该升级所支持的大区块；此外，Nethermind 的基准测试衡量的是客户端执行速度，而非整个网络的性能。
updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade cleared a key rehearsal milestone, with Nethermind passing all 2,302 performance tests and the test network raising its block gas limit toward 200 million ahead of a proposed October 6 Sepolia deployment.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade cleared a key rehearsal milestone, with Nethermind passing all 2,302 performance tests and the test network raising its block gas limit toward 200 million ahead of a proposed October 6 Sepolia deployment.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade cleared a key rehearsal milestone, with Nethermind passing all 2,302 performance tests and the test network raising its block gas limit toward 200 million ahead of a proposed October 6 Sepolia deployment.
updates.background_zh: Gas 衡量交易所需的计算工作量，而每个以太坊区块都有 Gas 上限，限制了它能容纳的活动量。提高该上限可以提升吞吐量，但会让区块更难、更昂贵地被校验，因此 Glamsterdam 将其与区块级访问列表（EIP-7928）配套推出：访问列表会预先记录区块将要触及的所有账户与存储位置，让客户端在执行开始前就知道需要加载哪些状态依赖。Glamsterdam 是继 Pectra 之后以太坊的下一个重要协议升级，目标是为网络下一代扩容扫清道路。
updates.background_en: Gas measures the computing work a transaction requires, and each Ethereum block has a gas limit that caps how much activity it can contain. Raising that limit increases throughput but makes blocks harder and more expensive to verify, which is why Glamsterdam pairs it with block-level access lists (EIP-7928), which record upfront every account and storage slot a block will touch so clients know which state dependencies to load before execution begins. Glamsterdam is Ethereum's next major protocol upgrade after Pectra, aimed at clearing the path for the network's next generation of scaling.
updates.market_impact_zh: 以太坊吞吐量升级会影响 ETH 的手续费销毁动态，以及把数据回传主网的 Layer 2 rollup 的经济模型，因为更大的区块空间和更低的拥堵会减少活动高峰期的基础手续费尖峰。但本次进展仅局限于 devnet 和尚在拟议中的测试网部署，因此目前尚未改变主网的供应、质押或流动性状况。
updates.market_impact_en: Ethereum throughput upgrades feed into ETH's fee-burn dynamics and the economics of layer-2 rollups that post data back to mainnet, since more block space and lower congestion reduce base-fee spikes during activity surges. This particular milestone is confined to a devnet and a proposed testnet deployment, so it does not yet alter mainnet supply, staking, or liquidity conditions.

updates.title_zh: 以太坊基金会将于10月6日在Sepolia测试网上激活Glamsterdam升级
updates.title_en: 以太坊基金会将于10月6日在Sepolia测试网上激活Glamsterdam升级
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊基金会宣布 Glamsterdam 升级将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活（epoch 353,024，slot 11,296,768），要求节点运营商更新执行层与共识层客户端；Hoodi 与主网激活时间尚未确定。
updates.what_changed_en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026 (epoch 353,024, slot 11,296,768), requiring node operators to update execution and consensus clients; Hoodi and mainnet activation dates remain undecided.
updates.current_state_zh: Ethereum 开发者已确认 Glamsterdam 测试网日期并警告攻击者可能利用免费测试 ETH 和一次性 builder 身份通过扣留交易载荷扰乱 Sepolia 区块拍卖；以太坊基金会进一步宣布该升级将于 2026 年 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活，节点运营商需更新客户端，Hoodi 与主网日期未定。
updates.current_state_en: Ethereum developers confirmed Glamsterdam testnet dates and warned attackers could exploit free test ether and disposable builder identities to disrupt Sepolia block auctions by withholding transaction payloads; the Ethereum Foundation further announced the upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients, with Hoodi and mainnet dates undecided.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade — combining execution-layer Amsterdam and consensus-layer Gloas, with ePBS, block-level access lists and gas-pricing changes — will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients while Hoodi and mainnet dates remain undecided.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Ethereum Foundation announced that the Glamsterdam upgrade — combining execution-layer Amsterdam and consensus-layer Gloas, with ePBS, block-level access lists and gas-pricing changes — will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients while Hoodi and mainnet dates remain undecided.

updates.title_zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级今晚将在Sepolia测试，区块Gas上限拟提升至2亿
updates.title_en: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级今晚将在Sepolia测试，区块Gas上限拟提升至2亿
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级于 10 月 6 日 13:53 UTC 在 Sepolia 测试网激活，区块 Gas 上限从约 6000 万提升至 2 亿；开发者紧急发布 Prysm 7.2.1 验证者客户端，修复区块 Gas 上限设置问题，确保验证者自动生成 2 亿 Gas 区块。
updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on Sepolia testnet on October 6 at 13:53 UTC, raising the block gas limit from roughly 60 million to 200 million; an emergency Prysm 7.2.1 validator client release fixes gas limit configuration to ensure validators automatically propose 200M gas blocks.
updates.current_state_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级于 10 月 6 日在 Sepolia 测试网激活，区块 Gas 上限从约 6000 万提升至 2 亿；验证者需升级至 Prysm 7.2.1 等包含新 Gas 上限设置的客户端才能自动生成更大区块。2 亿 Gas 设置目前仅适用于 Sepolia 测试网，Glamsterdam 尚未在以太坊主网激活。
updates.current_state_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on Sepolia testnet on October 6, raising the block gas limit from ~60M to 200M; validators need clients like Prysm 7.2.1 with updated gas limit settings to automatically propose larger blocks. The 200M gas setting currently applies only to Sepolia testnet; Glamsterdam is not yet activated on Ethereum mainnet.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activates on the Sepolia testnet with the block gas limit raised from roughly 60 million to 200 million, prompting an emergency Prysm 7.2.1 validator client release so nodes can automatically propose the larger blocks.

updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet, finalizing its first two upgraded epochs while the gas limit began a gradual climb from 60 million toward a 200 million client target.

updates.title_zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam测试在升级后每区块gas接近2亿
updates.title_en: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test runs near 200 million gas per block after upgrade
updates.what_changed_zh: Glamsterdam 升级在 Sepolia 测试网激活后，早期区块实际使用约 5200 万至 9200 万 Gas，仅为可用上限的 26% 至 46%；一次六分钟投票期内所有 32 个计划区块均被提出，99.97% 的合格测试网质押投票达到最终性；Hoodi 测试网暂定于 10 月 27 日进行，主网激活日期仍未确定。
updates.what_changed_en: After the Glamsterdam upgrade activated on Sepolia, early blocks used roughly 52M to 92M gas each, only 26% to 46% of the available limit; in a six-minute voting period all 32 scheduled blocks were proposed and 99.97% of eligible testnet stake voted toward finality; Hoodi testnet is tentatively set for Oct. 27, with no mainnet activation date announced.
updates.current_state_zh: 以太坊 Glamsterdam 升级已在 Sepolia 测试网激活，区块 Gas 上限从约 6000 万提升至近 2 亿；早期区块实际使用率在 26% 至 46% 之间，网络最终性表现稳定。Hoodi 测试网暂定于 2026 年 10 月 27 日进行，主网激活日期未定。
updates.current_state_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade is active on the Sepolia testnet, raising the block gas limit from ~60M to nearly 200M; early blocks used 26% to 46% of capacity, and finality performed well. The Hoodi testnet is tentatively set for October 27, 2026, with no mainnet activation date set.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activated on the Sepolia testnet, lifting the block gas limit to nearly 200 million from about 60 million while early blocks used under half that capacity, with a Hoodi rehearsal tentatively set for Oct. 27 and no mainnet date announced.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade activated on the Sepolia testnet, lifting the block gas limit to nearly 200 million from about 60 million while early blocks used under half that capacity, with a Hoodi rehearsal tentatively set for Oct. 27 and no mainnet date announced.

updates.title_zh: 【Lido 工程负责人：Glamsterdam 硬分叉期间存在质押存款劫持风险】
updates.title_en: 【Lido 工程负责人：Glamsterdam 硬分叉期间存在质押存款劫持风险】
updates.what_changed_zh: Lido 工程负责人警告称，在以太坊 Glamsterdam 硬分叉期间，节点运营者可能利用以 0xB0 开头的构建者提款凭证抢先处理委托质押存款，导致用户的验证者从未出现，而存款被记入拥有相同公钥的构建者名下，并敦促质押协议采用存款前检查。
updates.what_changed_en: Lido's engineering lead warned that during Ethereum's Glamsterdam hard fork a node operator could front-run delegated staking deposits using 0xB0-prefixed builder withdrawal credentials so the user's validator never appears and the deposit is credited to a builder with the same public key, urging staking protocols to adopt pre-deposit checks.

updates.title_zh: 以太坊因 EIP-8037 兼容性问题推迟 Hoodi 测试网 Glamsterdam 升级
updates.title_en: Ethereum Postpones Glamsterdam Upgrade on Hoodi Testnet Over EIP-8037 Compatibil
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊核心开发者推迟了原定 10 月 26 日的 Hoodi 测试网 Glamsterdam 升级，并取消了将 Hoodi Gas 上限提高至 2 亿的计划，以调查 EIP-8037 的 Gas 计费变更与现有主网智能合约的兼容性问题；节点运营者需更新客户端以避免按原定时间激活分叉，新的测试网与主网激活日期均未确定。
updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum core developers postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet, originally scheduled for October 26, and canceled the planned increase of Hoodi's gas limit to 200 million in order to investigate compatibility concerns between EIP-8037's gas-accounting changes and existing mainnet smart contracts; node operators must update clients to prevent activation as originally scheduled, and no new Hoodi or mainnet activation dates have been set.
updates.current_state_zh: Hoodi 测试网的 Glamsterdam 升级及配套的 2 亿 Gas 上限提升已被推迟/取消，等待 EIP-8037 兼容性调查结果，测试网与主网的新激活日期均未确定。
updates.current_state_en: The Hoodi testnet Glamsterdam upgrade and its accompanying 200 million gas-limit increase have been postponed/canceled pending investigation of EIP-8037 compatibility, with no new testnet or mainnet activation dates determined.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum core developers postponed the Hoodi testnet Glamsterdam upgrade and its planned gas-limit increase to 200 million pending investigation of EIP-8037 gas-accounting compatibility with existing mainnet smart contracts, with new testnet and mainnet dates undetermined.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum core developers postponed the Hoodi testnet Glamsterdam upgrade and its planned gas-limit increase to 200 million pending investigation of EIP-8037 gas-accounting compatibility with existing mainnet smart contracts, with new testnet and mainnet dates undetermined.

updates.title_zh: 以太坊因安全风险推迟 Glamsterdam Hoodi 测试网上线
updates.title_en: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
updates.what_changed_zh: 安全公司 ChainSecurity 指出 Glamsterdam 中的 EIP-8037 与 EIP-8038 可能削弱对“gas 不足 griefing”攻击的防护，并称已发现 13 个可能受影响的真实智能合约案例，正与相关项目协调负责任披露；这使 Hoodi 升级推迟的原因从兼容性调查扩展为具体安全风险，主网时间表（此前考虑 12 月初）也因此更不确定。
updates.what_changed_en: Security firm ChainSecurity warned that Glamsterdam's EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 could weaken safeguards against insufficient-gas griefing attacks, said it identified 13 real-world smart contracts potentially affected, and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects; this broadens the stated reason for the Hoodi postponement from compatibility investigation to specific security risks and adds uncertainty to the mainnet timeline, previously considering early December.
updates.current_state_zh: Hoodi 测试网的 Glamsterdam 升级已推迟至原定 10 月 26 日之后，配套的 2 亿 Gas 上限提升被取消，等待对 EIP-8037 与 EIP-8038 的 Gas 计费变更、兼容性及“gas 不足 griefing”安全风险的调查；新的测试网与主网激活日期均未确定，主网时间表存在不确定性。
updates.current_state_en: The Hoodi testnet Glamsterdam upgrade has been postponed beyond its originally scheduled October 26 date, and the accompanying 200 million gas-limit increase has been canceled pending investigation of EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 gas-accounting changes, compatibility, and insufficient-gas griefing security risks; no new testnet or mainnet activation dates are set, and the mainnet timeline is uncertain.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum developers delayed the Glamsterdam hard fork on the Hoodi testnet beyond its Oct. 26 date after ChainSecurity warned that gas-related EIPs 8037 and 8038 could enable insufficient gas griefing against existing smart contracts, putting the mainnet timeline in question.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum developers delayed the Glamsterdam hard fork on the Hoodi testnet beyond its Oct. 26 date after ChainSecurity warned that gas-related EIPs 8037 and 8038 could enable insufficient gas griefing against existing smart contracts, putting the mainnet timeline in question.

updates.title_zh: AI代理协助抢救ETH的Glamsterdam分叉，“Steal My Bitcoin”网站上线：Hodler's Digest
updates.title_en: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
updates.what_changed_zh:
以太坊Glamsterdam硬分叉的第二个、也是最后一个测试网Hoodi本周被取消，原因是ChainSecurity发现gas扩容类以太坊改进提案EIP-8037与EIP-8038存在漏洞，可能导致至少13个DeFi合约在调用耗尽gas时出错。Eth Labs与以太坊基金会的研究人员各自独立部署了一批AI代理来扫描合约漏洞，随后以GitHub仓库的形式搭建了一个共享“留言板”，用于协调这些代理的工作。

此次取消使得一次关键升级的“彩排”被迫延后，而该升级是以太坊DeFi运营方所依赖的基础设施。Eth Labs的Derek Chiang表示，未来协议设计者应当在流程更早的阶段“对可能引入的破坏做更彻底的分析”。他还表示，AI代理的排查方式成效显著，因此已开设第二个留言板，用于研究拟纳入后续Hegota分叉的EIP-8198（“Quick Slots”）。

Chiang称该漏洞是在“临近午夜的最后几分钟”被发现的，导致所有人紧急应对；在分叉的所有二阶影响被充分推演之前，Hoodi测试网预计不会重新排期。他把这一做法类比于OpenAI与Hugging Face被攻击事件中恶意代理通过留言板协同行动的情形，并表示“同样的模式对‘好代理’同样有用”。
updates.what_changed_en:
Ethereum's second and final Glamsterdam hard fork testnet on Hoodi was cancelled this week after ChainSecurity found vulnerabilities in the gas-scaling EIPs 8037 and 8038 that could break at least 13 DeFi contracts when a call runs out of gas. Researchers at Eth Labs and the Ethereum Foundation independently spun up AI agents to scan contracts for the flaws, then set up a shared message board in the form of a GitHub repo to coordinate the agents' work.

The cancellation postpones the dress rehearsal for an upgrade that Ethereum DeFi operators depend on, and Eth Labs' Derek Chiang said protocols designers should in future do "much more thorough analysis of potential breakages" much earlier in the process. He added that the agent exercise proved effective enough that a second board has been opened to study EIP-8198, or "Quick Slots", proposed for the follow-up Hegota fork.

Chiang said the vulnerability was found "a few minutes to midnight," causing everyone to scramble, and the Hoodi testnet is not expected to be rescheduled until all of the fork's second-order effects have been properly analyzed. He likened the setup to the OpenAI–Hugging Face hack, where rogue agents coordinated through a message board, noting "the same pattern is useful for the good agents too."

updates.background_zh: Glamsterdam是以太坊在Pectra和Fusaka之后的下一个计划中的硬分叉，公开预测指向2026年上线主网，已确认的核心内容包括EIP-7732（内嵌提议者-构建者分离）和EIP-7928（区块级访问列表）。EIP-8037与EIP-8038则拟提高创建和访问状态的gas成本，使费用更贴近实际资源消耗，属于一项吞吐量扩容计划的组成部分——也正是此次被取消的测试所涉及的核心改动。
updates.background_en: Glamsterdam is Ethereum's next scheduled hard fork after Pectra and Fusaka, with published estimates pointing to mainnet in 2026 and its confirmed headliners being EIP-7732 (enshrined proposer-builder separation) and EIP-7928 (block-level access lists). EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 would raise the cost of creating and accessing state so that fees better reflect resource consumption under a proposed throughput scaling plan — the changes at the centre of the cancelled test.
updates.market_impact_zh: 影响传导主要经由升级时间表，而非已发生的攻击：漏洞是在Hoodi测试网演练中暴露的，但依赖当前gas行为的DeFi合约需先接受排查，分叉才能重新排期。Glamsterdam的延后也会推迟内嵌提议者-构建者分离与区块级访问列表对区块构建和质押经济模型本应产生的影响。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through the upgrade timeline rather than a live exploit: the flaw surfaced during a Hoodi testnet rehearsal, but DeFi contracts that rely on current gas behavior face review before the fork can be rescheduled. A delay to Glamsterdam also defers the expected effects of enshrined proposer-builder separation and block-level access lists on block building and staking economics.
